question: Should this v0.7.9 release cut merge once release-check completes successfully for commit 2c84a02b9d4d7b43ce5cd5afaf0bf3c7382d8838?
rationale: A collaborator-authored release PR requires an explicit release-owner decision; automated cleanup should not close or independently accept a version cut.

options.title: Merge after release validation
options.body: Merge when release-check confirms artifacts for the current head and the release owner accepts the v0.7.9 notes.

options.title: Hold this release cut
options.body: Keep the PR open and revise the release contents if release validation exposes a platform or packaging regression.

recommendation.title: Merge after release validation
recommendation.body: Merge when release-check confirms artifacts for the current head and the release owner accepts the v0.7.9 notes.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the active release-cut commit and are the available collaborator connected to this release decision.
